transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’m just… completely worn out. Even getting from my bedroom to the kitchen feels like I’ve been hauling lumber all day. And when I rest, it doesn’t really help. I don’t feel like I get anything back.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in your usual activities?

Yeah. I used to look forward to things—choir, playing pickup ball, working on cars, grilling for the family. Now I just… don’t care enough to do any of it. People text me about showing up, and I can’t even make myself answer most of the time.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About four months now. It really started after my wife went back to working full-time, and I was by myself most weekdays. Since then it’s just kind of stayed this way.
Have you felt this way every day, most of the day, for at least two weeks straight during this four-month period?
Yes. It’s been pretty much every day, most of the day. It’s been going on about four months now, since my wife went back to full-time work and I started being alone most weekdays.
Have you had days where you felt so down or hopeless that you couldn't function normally at work or at home?

Yeah. Most days now I’m not really functioning like I should. I can’t keep up with the house, and I don’t follow through on the handyman stuff I planned to do. It just sits there.

And when the thoughts get bad… my wife gets scared to leave me alone. I don’t really trust myself then either.
Have you had any other periods in the past two years when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble functioning like you have now?
I’m not really sure. Nothing like this that I can remember. I’ve had bad days before, but not this kind of being down and not functioning for so long.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or irritable, where you didn’t need much sleep or thought faster than usual?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t remember any times where I was unusually up or full of energy like that, or not needing sleep. Mostly it’s been the opposite.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt extremely confident, unusually irritable, or so energetic that others noticed you were acting out of character?

No, not that I can think of. I don’t remember ever being so confident or energetic that people thought I wasn’t acting like myself. Irritable maybe just in a normal way sometimes, but not some big change like that.
Have you ever had a period in your life lasting two years or more where you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day, more days than not?
I don’t think so. I’ve had stretches where I was down, but I can’t say it was for two years or more, most days. Nothing that clearly fits that, as far as I remember.
Have you ever had a time in your life, even for just a few days, when you felt unusually upbeat, energetic, or confident—so much so that other people noticed a change in your behavior or mood?
No, I really don’t think I’ve had anything like that. I can’t remember a time where I was suddenly upbeat or full of energy and people noticed. That just doesn’t sound like me.
Have there been times during this period when something good happened—like seeing a friend or doing something you used to enjoy—and your mood actually improved, even if just for a little while?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed my mood lifting much, even when something good happens. Maybe there are brief moments where I’m distracted, but I wouldn’t say I really feel better.
Have you ever noticed that your mood can brighten up a bit in response to positive events, even if just for a short time, like if something good happens or someone says something nice to you?

I’m not sure I’ve really noticed that. If someone says something nice, I might register it, but I don’t feel my mood actually brighten much. It’s more like… maybe a brief distraction, and then I’m back where I was.
Have you had any previous episodes of feeling down or losing interest in things that lasted for a couple of weeks or more, even if they weren’t as severe as what you’re experiencing now?
I’m not really sure. I don’t have a clear memory of other times that lasted weeks like this. I may have had rough periods before, but I can’t say they were the same or that they went on that long.

Before this current period, have you ever had an episode where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, and then had at least two months without those symptoms before this current time began?

I don’t know. I can’t really point to a clear episode like that before this—where it lasted two weeks and then went away for a couple months. I’ve had low times, but I’m not sure they fit that pattern.

Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, did you ever have a time when you felt this way for at least two weeks, and then later felt back to normal for a couple of months before this started again?
I don’t really know. I can’t think of a clear time before this where it lasted that long and then I was back to normal for a couple months. My memory of it isn’t that clear.

Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, did you ever have a time when you felt this way for at least two weeks, and then later felt back to normal for a couple of months before this started again?

I don’t think I can answer that clearly. I can’t remember a definite period like that before this started—two weeks or more, and then being normal again for a couple months. It’s just not clear to me.
Before this current time, did you ever have a period of at least two weeks where you felt down or lost interest in things, then felt back to normal for a couple of months before this happened again?
I’m not sure. I don’t remember having a clear stretch like that before—where it lasted at least two weeks and then I was really back to normal for a couple months.
